name: Stone–Campbell movement

facts.value: Early 19th century. Stone's group took the name Christians in 1804. Stone and Campbell followers united at Lexington in January 1832

citations.excerpt: in 1804 with his five fellow ministers signed “The Last Will and Testament of the Springfield Presbytery,” giving up that name and calling themselves “Christians.”
in January 1832 at Lexington, Kentucky, the followers of the Campbells and those of Stone (who had stressed union more than primitive Christianity) united.
Stone had been a Presbyterian minister prominent in the Kentucky revival of 1801
